children: Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei urged labs to slow down before chatbots spiral out of control. It turbocharges a vibe shift ahead of his company's planned $2 trln IPO. Unlike the Cuban Missile Crisis or Covid-19's acute phase, investors are largely unfazed by theoretical tech risks.
Full view will be published shortly.
Follow Jonathan Guilford on X and LinkedIn.

Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei published an essay on September 12 entitled, "We must pace the frontier," calling on the AI industry to slow the rate at which it is improving the capabilities of new models.
Elon Musk and Sam Altman, the respective bosses of SpaceX and OpenAI, both said in posts on X the same day that they agree with Amodei's proposals.
President Donald Trump said in a Truth Social post on September 14 that the only AI "guardrails" needed are a "strong and smart" president.
